verdict_reason: The Branch-to-Destination swap is sound, but the renamed no-JavaScript test leaves a coverage.json link pointing at a title that no longer exists.

todos.issue: The PR renames the no-JavaScript test from 'after a refused save of Branch, choosing it again shows the address, the contact details and the ticked role entered' to '...of Destination, Consignee or Importer...' (address-type.fit.spec.js:226), but openspec/coverage/ins/address-book/coverage.json:5253 (workspace review clone) still links the old title, so the spec claims coverage by a test that no longer exists.
todos.fix: Must: every coverage.json link to address-type.fit.spec.js names a test title that exists in the file. One way: point coverage.json:5253 at the new title and drop 'Branch' from its note.
